references.text: The burnt offering shall be a bull or a ram without defect, as described here with a young bull from the herd.
A calf and a lamb, both one year old, were to be brought as a burnt offering, just as in this verse.
The same offerings were given by Nahshon on the first day: a young bull, a ram, and a one-year-old lamb for the burnt offering.
Nethanel gave the same offerings for the burnt offering: a young bull, a ram, and a one-year-old lamb.
Eliab gave identical offerings for the burnt offering as described here.
At the new moon, two young bulls, a ram, and seven one-year-old lambs were to be offered as a burnt offering.
One-year-old lambs were used as the daily burnt offering on the altar, corresponding to the lamb mentioned here.
